verdict.rationale: CDP documents a first-party Sandbox described as a fully isolated testing environment for custodial features without connecting real funds. It uses the same endpoints, authentication and response formats as Live, and supports test verification outcomes via magic SSN values. The documented scope is limited to custodial features, so isolation for the non-custodial wallet, x402, Onramp and agentic-wallet flows is not shown. missing for 10: sandbox coverage beyond custodial features (non-custodial wallets, x402, Onramp/Offramp, Agentic Wallet), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox stays isolated from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Sandbox is a fully isolated testing environment for custodial features without connecting real funds.
It uses the same endpoints, authentication, and response formats as Live, so there's nothing new to learn when you're ready to ship.
